objective: Freeze point-in-time control families, missingness semantics and source dependencies before any historical valuation outcome join.

listingAge.rule: listingAgeSessions/days must use the active membership episode; no current-listing backfill across reused/relisted identities.

candidateMetrics: past-only median tradeValue over frozen lookback
past-only median volumeShares over frozen lookback
liquidity.rule: Only exact PIT-eligible canonical A1 rows may enter; missing symbol-sessions remain explicit UNKNOWN.
liquidity.blocker: Canonical TWSE annual A1 coverage matrix is physically accepted through 2024 but 2025/2026 rows are still PENDING at contract freeze.

trendAndRelativeStrength.source: System2 historical A1 price history plus a continuity-safe price-return layer
trendAndRelativeStrength.rule: Do not compute return/trend/RS from RAW prices across unverified corporate-action continuity. Require adjusted/continuity-proven return lineage or mark UNKNOWN.
trendAndRelativeStrength.blocker: Historical A1 matrix reports continuityReadiness PARTIAL_UNVERIFIED; raw close series cannot be silently treated as total-return/adjusted history.

size.rule: Historical market capitalization requires PIT shares-in-issue/capitalization or an equivalent licensed official historical source.
size.blocker: Do not multiply current shares outstanding by historical price. Public canonical A1 price-volume rows do not contain historical shares in issue. TWSE index-constituent files with shares/market cap are subscription data and are not assumed licensed.

industryPeer.rule: Current industry classification cannot backfill historical peer membership. If no PIT classification vintage exists for scanDate, state=UNKNOWN.

marketRegime.rule: Use only a frozen PIT market-regime receipt valid at scanDate. Do not rebuild regime after observing valuation outcomes.

fundamentalState.rule: Only financial information known by scanDate is eligible. Later filings/actuals/revisions cannot backfill.

corporateActionContext.owner: D03 lifecycle/corporate-action normalization plus System2 historical continuity evidence
corporateActionContext.rule: Corporate-action state is a control/context tag. Unknown lifecycle evidence remains UNKNOWN and cannot be treated as no action.

historicalA1ReadinessAtFreeze.interpretation: 2022-2024 supplies a verified raw price-volume basis for early scan dates, but 2025-2026 control materialization must not bypass the DATA_LANE canonical backfill. Continuity-dependent return controls remain blocked even where raw data coverage passes.

missingnessPolicy.memberAccounting: Every valuation cohort member remains exactly one control row per scanDate.
missingnessPolicy.dependencyFailure: Emit explicit UNKNOWN state + reason code + source/readiness receipt reference.
missingnessPolicy.commonSupport: Every later outcome estimand must freeze and report its required-control common-support denominator before reading returns.

preOutcomeGates: 44 scan dates have one control row for every frozen valuation cohort member
control coverage/missingness receipt is frozen and immutable
2025/2026 canonical historical price-volume dependency is resolved or affected controls remain explicitly UNKNOWN
return-based trend/RS controls have continuity-safe lineage or remain explicitly UNKNOWN
historical size is never synthesized from current share count
PIT industry/fundamental/regime dependencies are either frozen or explicitly UNKNOWN
common-support rules for confirmatory tests are frozen before outcomes
exactNextContinuationPoint: Wait for canonical 2025/2026 TWSE historical A1 completion from DATA_LANE, then implement a 44-date control materializer that consumes canonical packs and explicit upstream dependency receipts; do not duplicate DATA_LANE backfill.
